summary: CWE-600: bad() calls InetAddress.getByName() on the remote address and declares `throws IOException`. getByName can throw UnknownHostException (an IOException subclass), which propagates uncaught out of the servlet entry point. The fix wraps the resolution and its use in a try/catch for UnknownHostException, logging the failure instead of letting it escape. Valid, resolvable addresses still produce the same IP output, so the feature is preserved.
